title: When the Verdict Sings
author: Theo Crane
blurb: Yara Underhill, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
